description: The GEOGLAM Crop Monitor provides open, timely and science-driven information on crop conditions to support market transparency and early warning of production shortfalls. Its site presents crop condition information and a section to analyse the key baseline and Earth observation satellite data products used for global agricultural monitoring. Coverage is global. Access to the reports, maps and data pages is free on the website; the licence is not stated on the home page read. Caveats: only the home page was readable from this session, so report cadence and data formats were not confirmed. For simulation it gives near-real-time crop condition and drought signals for early warning, food-system shock and agricultural hazard scenarios. Related catalogue records include the AMIS market data, JRC MARS agri4cast and FAO GAEZ.
